optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Cloud Resource Engineer, Customer Service Centre Platform
professionalSummary: Experienced AWS cloud administrator with two years managing accounts, quotas, and tagging for a retail bank’s customer service centre platform. Demonstrated incident response under pressure, including on-call rota participation and real‑time communication with operations teams. Skilled in monthly capacity and cost reviews, right‑sizing proposals, and runbook maintenance.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess fit based on evidence and gaps.

role.roleTitle: Cloud Resource Engineer, Customer Service Centre Platform

evidence.text: Managed the platform's three AWS accounts, quota requests and the tagging policy for the telephony and chat services, keeping the resource inventory current in the CMDB after each change window.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of account and tagging management.

evidence.text: Served on the platform on-call rota for nine months and handled the June chat-service outage as first responder: paged at 07:40, identified the exhausted NAT gateway allocation, applied the quota increase and posted status updates to contact-centre operations every fifteen minutes until service was restored at 08:55.

Ran the monthly capacity and cost review with the platform lead, proposing right-sizing of the chat-service instances with the expected monthly saving and the rollback path documented in the change record.
Responsibilities included account administration, on-call incident response, capacity reviews and runbook maintenance for the contact-centre platform over two years.
evidence.notes: Mentions coordination but no explicit change window coordination or responsibility boundaries.

missingEvidence: Specific evidence of coordinating change windows with contact-centre operations and documented responsibility boundaries.

evidence.text: Responsibilities included account administration, on-call incident response, capacity reviews and runbook maintenance for the contact-centre platform over two years.
evidence.notes: Mentions runbook maintenance but no explicit documentation of runbooks, known limitations, or hand-over conditions.
